articles.author: Sarah Kliff and Margot Sanger-Katz
articles.title: Trump Administration Delays Enforcement of Medicaid Work Requirement
articles.description: The federal government had planned to require poor adults to prove they were working or lose insurance coverage starting Jan. 1. Now, it will let states wait until July.

articles.title: Kennedy’s Future: Will Democrats Try to Impeach Him, or Actually Work With Him?
articles.description: Most Democrats abhor the health secretary’s stance on vaccines, but some see an opportunity to win voters from his MAHA movement by joining with him on food and environmental issues.
